answer: The admission bond is time locked for 18 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are written down in grove, expire in gale, and haven lists each expiry. An farming party running 146 aliases therefore needs 179 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1007 identities would post 4737 proofs and burn roughly 21 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
